version: V203.0 scoped actual evidence and conditional memory age
authority: Continue improving weight-space programming, with no game adaptation or gradient training.
hypotheses: Local actual improvement should not require global significance or overwrite unrelated conditions.
New evidence from similar conditions is a more relevant age unit than unrelated global interactions; may trade stability for adaptability.
construction: New separately authored initial neural weights. All V202 shared parameters are reproduced exactly by the original analytic writer; only new decay/local readouts added. No parameters change during episodes.

interface.initial_condition_scope: exact public observation identity; no generalization of adoption to untested starting conditions

fixed_new_program.conditional_age: sum of similarity of newer records to the current query
fixed_new_program.local_adoption: matching_pair_count>=2 and estimated_difference>0; ties and negative differences retain prior route
fixed_new_program.uncertainty: sample standard error reported, not a hard global significance veto; no statistical correctness certificate

chronology: Real discovery -> freeze candidate and incumbent routes -> fresh paired actual trials -> local/global adoption -> add actual trial transitions to future working memory -> paired heldout after/before evaluations with no memory writes. Route chooses one frozen whole policy at episode start; no mid-episode mixing.
evaluation: Report all 16 seeds and all five controls on same new task instances and exogenous tapes. Equal total and role-specific environment costs. First/last four cycles, reversal early window, whole evaluation, and independent paired adoption wins/losses. Shadow results cannot enter decisions.
preservation: Exclusive evidence namespace, preserve first failure/partial/timeout, no automatic retry or post-result tuning; no old fixtures rerun or executed source edits. Original V202 model runs only as declared control on new instances.
limitations: These are mechanism controls, not historical four reward/penalty training arms.
Conditional decay is not automatic causal change identification.
Exact repeated initial conditions limit scope; no raw semantic/vision encoder.
Small-pair local selection can overfit chance and is evaluated honestly.
No independent expert certification, no SLEEP consolidation, no trained-baseline superiority claim.
adoption: Standalone prototype checkpoint and report only; no deployment in prior learner and no automation.
